format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <script>customElements.whenDefined('sf-message-log').then(() => {const log = document.querySelector('#log');log.renderMessage = (message) => { const node = document.createElement('article'); node.className = 'host-message'; node.textContent = message.text; const button = document.createElement('button'); button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'copy'; button.textContent = 'Копировать'; node.append(' ', button); return node; };log.setMessages([{"id": "m1", "author": "anna", "author-name": "Анна", "text": "Добрый день!"}, {"id": "m2", "author": "anna", "author-name": "Анна", "text": "Отчёт готов?"}, {"id": "m3", "author": "me", "own": true, "text": "Да, отправил утром."}], {hasMore: true});});</script>

probes.title: from a focused message ArrowUp and ArrowDown go to the neighbour, Home and End to the first and last loaded
probes.covers: keyboard.row ArrowUp focus:prev, ArrowDown focus:next, Home focus:first, End focus:last, accessibility.name runtime.region-label

probes.title: ArrowUp on the first message asks load-more {direction: before, before} once and the old load-earlier once, noted; a refused request lets the button be pressed again
a growing reply: begun once; each chunk is chunk {id, revision} and redraws that entry only, in place -- the item and the focused button stay; the end is completed and the busy mark goes
probes.covers: events.begun, events.chunk, events.completed (§10.8), §18.4 in place, migration item 31

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g1', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Чтобы', revision: '1', growing: true}), true)

(document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g1', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Чтобы вернуть', revision: '2', growing: true}), document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g1', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Чтобы вернуть товар,', revision: '3', growing: true}), true)
steps.check: document.querySelector('#log').querySelector('.sf-message-log__item[data-id="g1"]') === window.__item && document.activeElement === window.__copy && document.querySelector('#log').querySelector('.sf-message-log__item[data-id="g1"]').querySelector('article').firstChild.data === 'Чтобы вернуть товар,' && window.__others.every((node) => node.isConnected)

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g1', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Чтобы вернуть товар, откройте заказ.', revision: '4', growing: false}), true)

probes.title: cancel {id} ends a growing reply cancelled at once and draws none of the growth that follows; the busy mark goes

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g2', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Сейчас', revision: '1', growing: true}), true)
document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g2', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Сейчас расскажу', revision: '2', growing: true})

probes.title: a reply that ends with an error is failed {id, reason, message}; one the host marks wait stopped is cancelled

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g3', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Ищу', revision: '1', growing: true}), document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g3', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Ищу', revision: '2', growing: false, error: {reason: 'timeout', message: 'Нет ответа'}}), true)

(document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g4', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Думаю', revision: '1', growing: true}), document.querySelector('#log').upsert({id: 'g4', author: 'assistant', 'author-name': 'Ассистент', text: 'Думаю', revision: '2', growing: false, wait: 'stopped'}), true)

probes.title: the messages setting is compared by key: by content a changed entry is redrawn in place, by revision an unchanged revision is not drawn again; one that left is taken off

steps.script: (window.__m1 = document.querySelector('#log').querySelector('.sf-message-log__item[data-id="m1"]'), document.querySelector('#log').messages = [{id: 'm1', author: 'anna', 'author-name': 'Анна', text: 'Добрый день!!'}, {id: 'm3', author: 'me', own: true, text: 'Да, отправил утром.'}], true)

(document.querySelector('#log').setAttribute('changes', 'revision'), document.querySelector('#log').messages = [{id: 'm1', revision: '7', text: 'А'}, {id: 'm3', own: true, text: 'Да, отправил утром.'}], document.querySelector('#log').messages = [{id: 'm1', revision: '7', text: 'Б'}, {id: 'm3', own: true, text: 'Да, отправил утром.'}], true)
(document.querySelector('#log').messages = [{id: 'm1', revision: '8', text: 'Б'}, {id: 'm3', own: true, text: 'Да, отправил утром.'}], true)

probes.title: remove(id), the 1.0 name, still takes a message off and is noted; detach answers outcomes; remove() without an id stays the browser's
